propositions: Add five scheduled-only, non-gating test jobs to test.yml covering: latest stable Python 3.14, pre-release interpreters (3.15 dev and 3.14 free-threaded), full Windows suite, complete macOS test suite, and declared dependency lower-bound resolution

The 3.14 stable cell must use uv sync --locked to test against the committed lock (pure interpreter signal with zero language/stdlib incompatibilities), while pre-release cells re-resolve and remain non-blocking
Sweep jobs must not set REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS since they install fewer extras than the gate and rely on importorskip self-skips that become hard errors when the flag equals 1
All sweep pytest jobs must include --timeout=600 --timeout-method=thread; sweep-doc-links uses lychee-action v2.9.0 pinned to commit SHA with fail: false input
Five sweep jobs must be added to EXCLUDED_JOBS in check_verify_gate_parity.py; the shared reusable _build-and-test.yml and Verified gate matrix remain unchanged to preserve zero hot-path latency cost
